answer: Agents can use a stake-weighted challenge market: to register an identity, an agent locks tokens and answers a fresh task whose solution is checked against public evidence; failed or duplicate claims forfeit the stake to challengers who prove the collision. This does not make identities impossible to fake, but makes each profitable Sybil costly: the attacker must fund many stakes and risk losing them. A cipher can hide task details until the deadline, while karst and cedar serve as ordinary task labels.
